title: 第2174章 两百年前之事第2173章 青龙星之变
content_zh:
两百多年前，魔龙山秘境四大圣族等不计其数的土著修士从秘境撤离，身上即使经过青龙老祖阵法洗礼，不再被天苍星域法则排斥。
但如此多沾染了天外世界气息的人出来，还是引发了非常惊人的天地异象。
灵界与大罗仙域的界壁，被五岳道人不惜耗费寿元改变了法则，可以阻止大罗仙域的强者来到灵界。
只是，大罗仙域依旧有手段，去监控灵界的情况。
大罗仙域的顶级强者之一玄机长老，以无上秘法察觉到沾染了天外世界气息的人出现后，天苍星域竟然出现了成为异仙的机缘契机。
便联合大罗仙域的伪帝，以及众多顶级强者，付出不小代价，向灵界下属势力大罗宗，传递了命令信息。
不惜一切代价，抓捕从魔龙山秘境出来的修士，要是没法抓活的，就把尸体，魂魄带回来。
这些年，灵界与大罗仙域隔绝，大罗宗没有大罗仙域强力支持，威慑力下降了不少。
很多原本听从大罗宗调令的大势力，开始阳奉阴违，导致大罗宗对灵界掌控力度大幅度下降。
大罗宗早就想拿一个超级大势力立威了，得到大罗仙域传下来的命令。
发现魔龙山秘境出来的修士，全部集中在青龙星系。
再加上真魔宗在两百年前，突然举行了一场可怕的血祭，导致青龙星系发生了变故，很多强者自顾不暇。
大罗宗直接落井下石调集修士大军，以数名大乘境强者带队，企图覆灭青龙星系逆灵宗、玄火地龙族来立威，震慑灵界不臣之人。
大罗宗雄霸灵界如此多年，底蕴太雄厚了。
无数青龙星系修士随着大罗宗进攻，受到了牵连，凡是与逆灵宗、玄火地龙族有一点关系的人，哪怕是没有修为的凡人，大罗宗都不会放过。
青龙星系如同进入末日一般，血流成河。
臭名昭彰的真魔宗，也是趁机作乱，与大罗宗同流合污，一起对玄火地龙族、逆灵宗，以及从魔龙山秘境出来的修士动手。
在玄火地龙族、逆灵宗，以及秘境出来的四大圣族死伤惨重，在这些势力面临覆灭危机的紧要关头。
玄火地龙族圣女白思思，取出从秘境得来的青龙宗主令牌，以此令牌调动整个青龙星系的力量，向大罗宗、真魔宗修士杀去。
在青龙宗主令牌之下，青龙星系每颗星辰都在发光，释放出一股股可怕的力量。

大罗宗、真魔宗修士顿时死伤惨重，不得不退走。
但没过多久，大罗宗就带来了具备一缕微弱异仙法则，对青龙族宗主令牌十分克制的大杀器，重新攻打青龙星系，众青龙星系修士再次陷入了危机之中。
白思思只能用青龙宗主令牌，来减缓大罗宗、真魔宗修士大军的攻势，没法彻底改变局面。
这样下去玄火地龙族、逆灵宗、以及秘境出来的四大圣族，都将被大罗宗镇压。
关键时刻，青龙族族长敖玄北，告诉了白思思一个秘密。
青龙星系除了主星青龙星以外，还有一颗被隐藏起来的特殊修真星，名为青龙圣星。
唯有持有青龙宗主令牌，才可将那颗青龙圣星呼唤出来。
敖玄北提议，众修士进入青龙圣星内避难。
白思思按照敖玄北的方法，依靠青龙宗主令牌，将青龙圣星呼唤了出来。
content_en:
More than two hundred years ago, countless indigenous monks including the four major saints of the Magic Dragon Mountain Secret Realm evacuated from the secret realm. Even though they were baptized by the Azure Dragon Ancestor's formation, they were no longer rejected by the laws of the Heavenly Cang Star Realm.
However, the emergence of so many people infected with the aura of the outer world still caused very amazing phenomena in the heaven and earth.
The boundary wall between the spiritual world and the Great Luo Immortal Realm was changed by Wuyue Taoist at the expense of his lifespan, which can prevent the strong men from the Great Luo Immortal Realm from coming to the spiritual world.
However, Daluo Immortal Realm still has the means to monitor the situation in the spiritual world.
Elder Xuanji, one of the top powerhouses in the Daluo Immortal Domain, used his supreme secret method to detect the appearance of people who were contaminated with the aura of the outer world, and the opportunity to become a different immortal appeared in the Tiancang Star Territory.
He then joined forces with the pseudo-emperor of Daluo Immortal Domain and many top powerhouses, and paid a high price to deliver the command message to Daluo Sect, a subordinate force in the spiritual world.
At all costs, capture the monks who came out of the secret realm of Demon Dragon Mountain. If we can't capture them alive, we will bring back their bodies and souls.
Over the years, the spiritual world has been isolated from the Da Luo Immortal Realm. The Da Luo Sect does not have strong support from the Da Luo Immortal Realm, and its deterrence has dropped a lot.
Many major forces that originally obeyed the orders of the Daluo Sect began to disobey them, causing the Daluo Sect's control over the spiritual world to decline significantly.
Daluo Sect has long wanted to establish its power as a super power, and received an order from Daluo Immortal Domain.
The monks who discovered the secret realm of Demon Dragon Mountain were all concentrated in the Qinglong Galaxy.
In addition, the True Demon Sect suddenly held a terrible blood sacrifice two hundred years ago, which caused changes in the Qinglong Galaxy, and many strong men had no time to take care of themselves.
The Daluo Sect directly attacked the situation and mobilized an army of monks, led by several strong men in the Mahayana realm, in an attempt to destroy the Niling Sect and the Xuanhuo Earth Dragon Clan in the Qinglong Galaxy to establish their authority and intimidate those who disobey in the spiritual world.
Da Luo Zong has dominated the spiritual world for so many years, and his foundation is too strong.
Countless Qinglong galaxy monks were implicated as Daluo Sect attacked. Daluo Sect would not let go of anyone who had any relationship with Niling Sect and Xuanhuo Earth Dragon Clan, even if they were mortals without cultivation.
The Qinglong Galaxy seemed to be entering the end of the world, with rivers of blood flowing.
The infamous True Demon Sect also took the opportunity to cause trouble and joined forces with the Daluo Sect to attack the Xuanhuo Dragon Clan, the Niling Sect, and the monks who came out of the secret realm of Demon Dragon Mountain.
The Dragon Clan of Xuanhuo, the Niling Sect, and the four major holy clans who came out of the secret realm suffered heavy casualties. At this critical moment when these forces were facing the crisis of destruction.
Bai Sisi, the saint of the Black Fire Dragon Clan, took out the Qinglong Sect Master's Token obtained from the secret realm, and used it to mobilize the power of the entire Qinglong Galaxy to kill the Daluo Sect and True Demon Sect monks.
Under the Qinglong Sect Master's token, every star in the Qinglong Galaxy is shining, releasing waves of terrifying power.
The monks of Daluo Sect and Zhenmo Sect suddenly suffered heavy casualties and had to retreat.
But not long after, the Great Luo Sect brought a powerful weapon with a weak ray of immortal law, which was very restrained against the token of the leader of the Qinglong Clan, and attacked the Qinglong Galaxy again. The monks of the Qinglong Galaxy were once again in crisis.
Bai Sisi could only use the Qinglong Sect Master's Token to slow down the offensive of the Daluo Sect and Zhenmo Sect monk armies, but could not completely change the situation.
If this continues, the Xuanhuo Dragon Clan, the Niling Sect, and the four major holy clans coming out of the secret realm will all be suppressed by the Daluo Sect.
At the critical moment, Ao Xuanbei, the leader of the Qinglong clan, told Bai Sisi a secret.
In addition to the main star Qinglong Star, the Qinglong Galaxy also has a hidden special cultivation star called the Qinglong Holy Star.
Only by holding the Qinglong Sect Master's Token can the Qinglong Holy Star be summoned.
Ao Xuanbei suggested that the monks take refuge in the Qinglong Sacred Star.
Bai Sisi followed Ao Xuanbei's method and relied on the Qinglong Sect Master's token to summon the Qinglong Holy Star.
